title: Hypatia Learned Security Rules
description: Named-field JSON export of learned security rules, one entry per alert type. Produced by `mix hypatia.batch_security_scan`; semantics are Hypatia.Rules.SecurityErrors.validate_alert/1 plus the observation count. See docs/rules/security-rule-provenance.adoc for the field-by-field mapping.

schema.description: Schema identifier for this document shape

version.description: Semantic version of the export format

source_alert_count.description: Total code-scanning alerts the rules were learned from

rules.description: One object per distinct alert type, sorted by observations descending then alert_type

category.description: Canonical alert category (snake-case as in the ECHIDNA security-learning source of record). ERROR-CATALOG.scm kebab-case names map by hyphen to underscore.

severity.description: Classified severity (source classify_severity/2; canonical source SecurityErrors.issue_severity/1)

auto_fixable.description: Whether an automated fix exists (source is_auto_fixable/1; canonical source SecurityErrors.auto_fixable?/1)

observations.description: Alerts of this type seen in the source scan. An observation count is belief-formation evidence, never a soundness claim: see schema/findings.ncl and src/Hypatia/ABI/Verdict.idr.

fix.description: Suggested fix text (source suggest_fix/2; canonical source SecurityErrors.fix_suggestion/1), or null when none is recorded

prevention_workflow.description: Prevention workflow template name (source get_prevention_workflow/2; canonical source SecurityErrors.prevention_workflow/1), or null when none is recorded
